wind_step.name: Wind Step
wind_step.lore: A fluid Lumorian discipline that bends momentum and air. Practitioners strike from impossible angles.

moves.name: Gale Kick
moves.desc: A whipping kick carried on a gust of wind.

moves.name: Sky Step
moves.desc: Leap upward — your next move comes from above. Cannot miss.

moves.name: Cyclone Cut
moves.desc: A spinning blade of compressed air.

sun_walk.name: Sun Walk
sun_walk.lore: A radiant style taught only in the Sanctuary's inner courtyard. Each step burns its impression into the air.

moves.name: Dawn Pillar
moves.desc: Call down a column of solar fire.
